title: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1

entities.name: Ruzi
entities.description: A legendary Selesnya Master Trainer who teaches young Wolf Riders, secretly trusts his wolf and bow more than the Worldsoul, and is sent to find his sister Cecilee.

entities.name: Kuma
entities.description: Ruzi's wolf and lifelong companion, who carries him across the rooftops.

entities.name: Mazena
entities.description: A dryad and one of Trostani's most trusted advisors, charismatic and legalistic, who sends Ruzi to the Rubblebelt.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya guildmaster whose teachings Mazena quotes and who senses a troubling situation.

entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: Ruzi's sister, who left Vitu-Ghazi to lead her own community in the Rubblebelt and has adopted a Gruul child.

entities.name: Young elf student
entities.description: A young elf wolf-rider student in her first training session who falls from the beam.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild of harmony and unity that Ruzi belongs to.

entities.name: Wolf Riders
entities.description: Selesnya riders bonded to wolves from youth, trained by Ruzi.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: The clans of the Rubblebelt whose abandoned child Cecilee adopted.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: A collective unconsciousness that Selesnyans believe guides them toward unity and harmony.

entities.name: District Riots
entities.description: A conflict in which Ruzi showed heroism.

entities.name: Training hall
entities.description: A combination obstacle course and classroom where Ruzi teaches.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: A ruined tract of land beyond the Tenth District where Cecilee's community lives.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya seat that Cecilee left.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane that Ruzi traverses by rooftop.

events.summary: A young elf falls with her wolf from a training beam during her first lesson, and Ruzi asks her to say what she did wrong.
events.quote: "Tell me what you did wrong," Ruzi said to his two-legged student.

events.summary: Ruzi and his wolf Kuma cross the high beam without hesitation to teach his students to trust their wolves.
events.quote: But Ruzi urged his wolf forward without hesitation.

events.summary: The dryad Mazena confronts Ruzi after class with a message from Guildmaster Trostani.
events.quote: We have an important message from Guildmaster Trostani, and you kept us standing for ages,

events.summary: Mazena orders Ruzi to leave today for the Rubblebelt because Trostani sensed a troubling situation.
events.quote: You must go to the Rubblebelt. You must leave today.

events.summary: Mazena makes clear that Ruzi must find his sister Cecilee, and he cannot say no.
events.quote: You want me to find my sister.

events.summary: Ruzi recalls Cecilee's departure for the Rubblebelt and her silence, and that she adopted a Gruul child named for him.
events.quote: He'd heard that she'd adopted an abandoned Gruul child to raise as her own.

events.summary: Ruzi and Kuma reach the edge of the Rubblebelt before dawn and must leave the rooftops to find Cecilee's community.
events.quote: Hours later, Ruzi and Kuma had reached the last roof at the edge of the Rubblebelt.

relations.note: He is the Master Trainer who teaches her.
relations.quote: As Master Trainer, Ruzi taught the youngest Selesnyans and their wolves to become Wolf Riders.
You want me to find my sister.
the three of them—Cecilee, Ruzi, and his wolf Kuma—had been inseparable.

relations.note: One of her most trusted advisors.
relations.quote: Mazena was one of Trostani's most trusted advisors.
We have an important message from Guildmaster Trostani
Ruzi was a legend among the Selesnyans, much to his annoyance.
